🚀 We are Ai Vibecoders

A crew of six space enthusiasts from Dushanbe, Tajikistan. We build things that make space science feel close, hands-on and a little bit fun. This is our second NASA Space Apps Challenge — our 2025 team was named a Global Nominee, and we came back to aim even higher.

👩‍🚀 The crew

Zokirov Dalerjon — team captain

Zokirov Sherzod

Hasanova Mavzuna

Zokirova Mukhiba

Sharipov Mahmudjon

Zokirova Maftuna

🛰️ This year's mission

For the Space Mission Design Game challenge we built Mission Architect — a browser game where you design a spacecraft, choose an orbit and a rocket, fly a year-long mission and get real NASA imagery back. Solo or as a crew of 2–4, every choice costs something elsewhere.

▶ Play it: https://sherzodchat-lang.github.io/mission-architect/

💡 What drives us

We believe the best way to learn how space missions work is to try one — make the trade-offs, watch it fail, understand why, and launch again. We love open data, clean design, games and building fast with modern tools.

Our motto: "We will win!"
